title: Wave 3: cochange from commit_files + behavioral tests
description: sutra_cochange always returns empty: git log --name-only with a pathspec filters output to that pathspec, so the skip-self filter drops everything (reproduced empirically). Health pipeline uses a different, working path (commit_files tables) so the two surfaces contradict. Tests assert shape only and pass on empty output. Findings: cochange-always-empty (HIGH), cochange-tests-vacuous (MEDIUM). Locations: src/git.rs:103-144, src/tools/cochange.rs, tests/cochange-test.rs.

acceptance_criteria.text: sutra_cochange answers from already-populated commit_files tables; broken git plumbing deleted
behavioral test: fixture repo with two files committed together twice yields non-empty cochange result
audit other git-backed tool tests for non-emptiness assertions; add where missing
sutra_cochange on src/components.rs against live index returns non-empty partners
